text_block_list.text:
On the day of the Fan Appreciation 
Festival, Haru Urara put her boundless 
energy to use by entering all sorts of 
events, but...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *gasp*, *wheeze*... The "Tire 
Pulling Race" is over!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"Guess what, guess what~... —I was dead 
last!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha~, totally! These tires are just so, 
so heavy~!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
With this, I'm dead last in the 'Rabbit 
Race', the 'Carrot Dig', AND the 'Pipe 
Rolling Race'!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Still—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Haru Urara just keeps on losing. Isn't it 
about time to give up already?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text:
"You bonehead, what are you talking 
about?! There's no way Urara-chan would 
give up!"

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local B
text_block_list.text: Urara-chan! Do your best!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"That's right, that's right! You still 
have a chance! Do your best!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: O-Ohh...! G-Go for it, Haru Urara!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, they're cheering even louder than at 
the start! Even though I'm losing, why~?

Every time Haru Urara enters a race, the 
fans go wild. They seem to love how she 
never gives up, no matter how many times 
she loses.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
If I win with this, everyone will surely 
be even happier!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I'm confident about the next Mud Race, so 
I'm totally gonna win! Yeah!
choice_data_list: Go out there and crush it!
Go out there and do your best!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
“—And just as the Fan Appreciation 
Festival reaches its climax, the Mud Race 
gets underway! The Umamusume push forward 
through the mire!”

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, and Haru Urara makes a break for it 
here! She's been racing back-to-back, but 
she's full of energy! Looks like she's 
going for a 'Front Runner' strategy, but 
what will be the result—?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Urara-ra-ra-ra-raaaaa!!!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Uuu, dead last again! Front-running 
might've been a huge mistake!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I wonder if everyone was disappointed~.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Guhh~, that was close! I'm sure you'll be 
fine next time!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Show me even more of that grit and guts!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Whaaa-?! Your voice is even louder than 
before!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Could this be...!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"Does that mean you have high hopes for me 
next time too!? All right, I'm gonna give 
it my all!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I was gonna take a break, but scratch 
that! I'm gonna go find an event I can 
enter!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Daaaassshhh!

No matter how durable Haru Urara is, 
overworking her body any further wouldn't 
be good, so I hurriedly stopped her...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Waaah~! 1st place, I got 1st place!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
You know, the mud was really heavy, so I 
just went whoosh and took off first!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Because whether I run fast or slow, I end 
up tired either way!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
So, I was thinking of zooming ahead right 
from the start, and when I get tired, just 
hanging in there nice and easy!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yay! Eheheh, I could totally become a 
trainer myself!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Haru Urara snapped her losing streak! Man, 
that's sheer tenacity for you!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Show us that kind of fiery passion in 
your races too!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Waah, she really was happy about it! 
Ehehe, I'm glad I worked so hard!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Everyone! I'm gonna win the race too, so 
come cheer for me!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaaah...!)

Showing off her sheer guts with a victory, 
Haru Urara thoroughly brought the house 
down!

After the event, Haru Urara spent time 
deepening her bonds with her fans.

text_block_list.name: Child
text_block_list.text:
U-chan, you like carrots, right? Here, 
have one!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Whoa, really?! Yaay, thank you!

text_block_list.name: Child
text_block_list.text:
"This is what they call 'baiting,' right?! 
Mommy said so!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, is that how it works! So that means 
you're "feeding" me, right?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, you can keep "feeding" me more, you 
know!

While watching Haru Urara play with her 
fans, I hear voices talking from somewhere 
behind me...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Haru Urara sure is popular. Well, she is 
pretty cute, after all.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Looks like she said she wants to run in 
the Arima Kinen, and with this much 
popularity, she might actually pull it 
off.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Wait, no way! I mean, Haru Urara is super 
cute, but she's not really strong or 
anything.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"No, there's still the fan vote, right? As 
long as we get enough votes, shouldn't 
there be a chance?"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Votes, huh... I'd probably vote for her. 
She's cute, after all.

The fan voting system. True, using that 
might increase our chances of entering, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text:
"...I see, so that was an option! I gotta 
go tell everyone right away."

That was someone from Haru Urara's fan 
club. They left before I could call out to 
them, though...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, Trainer! Everyone wants to take a 
photo together!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
We'll snap it on the count of three, so 
take the camera, please!

In any case, Haru Urara thoroughly 
thrilled the fans. The Fan Thanksgiving 
Festival ended in huge success!
